verdicts.claim: Settings help, including the colour-blind help, is cut off with '...' even at 1920x1080, so a player choosing a vision mode cannot read what it does.
verdicts.what_is_true: The public /play/ build (pin 257a766c) caps Settings help at two lines and cuts the rest with '...'. HEAD and the LAN builds fixed this in 9979146a (2026-10-28): the help area grows or scrolls and is never cut. The row counts at 1920x1080 come from an overflow report that was never saved, and I did not re-run it.
proof: 9979146a not an ancestor of 257a766c; is an ancestor of a8bc66e2
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. It is real and small, and only the record is stale for HEAD.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record: fixed at 9979146a, and still open only in the pinned public build until the pin moves. Moving the pin needs CI repaired first.

verdicts.claim: brace_style 'Button only' on a pad leaves brace_key unbound by default, stranding the player; two help lines did not match the build.
verdicts.what_is_true: This is still live in HEAD and in the LAN build a8bc66e2, where rightStick is on. Neither pad preset binds brace_key, and 'Button only' turns the flick brace off, so a pad player who picks it has no brace until they bind one. The help now says 'The button is L3 on Arena', but the arena preset binds no L3 brace, so the inventory's 'possibly fixed' note is wrong. The other two help lines (D-pad swap, quick fade) are fixed. The public pin has no brace_style option at all.
proof: evidence/AC-252.txt (no brace_key in arena or simple-pad at HEAD or a8bc66e2)
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. The record understates it now, because the help line points to a button that does nothing.
verdicts.fix: Controls binds a default pad brace (L3, as the help says), or the row opens the bind prompt when chosen. UI makes the help match. Add an input test that every assist choice leaves its action reachable.

verdicts.claim: Accessibility options are audited at each gate, and the checklist must pass at the P5 gate.
verdicts.what_is_true: The charter and CLAUDE.md:107 do set an accessibility audit at each gate and a checklist pass at P5. But docs/accessibility/checklist.md has never been committed, and /gate briefs only QA, Production Operations and Legal, so no gate audits accessibility. Only one audit exists (2026-10-28), and hold-to-flurry is still 'Not built'.
proof: evidence/AC-253.txt (checklist.md absent in HEAD and in all history)
.claude/commands/gate.md:5 lists QA, Production Operations, Legal only
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Carried as a safety gate, it gives false assurance: it reads as an enforced check, but the checklist does not exist and no gate runs it.
verdicts.fix: Move it to process. Accessibility writes checklist.md, and the EP adds Accessibility to the /gate briefing list. Track it as P5 work.

verdicts.claim: The audit rated 'no volume controls of any kind' and no mono option as P1, the most common accessibility ask.
verdicts.what_is_true: The public pin plays sound but has no volume or mono settings, so the gap is real on /play/. HEAD and the LAN builds have had Master, Effects and Voice volume plus Mono since 9979146a, a few hours after the audit, and these are wired to the audio buses. Browser and OS volume still work, so this is a gap against a basic guideline, not a P1 on a level with Legal's flash conditions.
external: https://gameaccessibilityguidelines.com/basic/ (accessed 2026-11-07): Basic includes "Provide separate volume controls or mutes for effects, speech and background / music"
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: A stale P1 'blocker' keeps an item that is already fixed on the release-blocker list, and ranks a volume slider with seizure conditions.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record: fixed at 9979146a, still open on /play/ until the pin moves, rated S3.

verdicts.claim: No difficulty choice is reachable; the AI has easy, medium and hard in data but neither the start menu nor Settings offers them.
verdicts.what_is_true: This is true only of the public pin 257a766c, which has no aiLevel anywhere. Since b6df7059 (2026-10-29), HEAD and the LAN builds have a Computer level row (Easy, Medium, Hard) on the 1-player start menu, passed to the sim as the setup's aiLevel. The inventory note looked in options.json, the wrong file.
proof: evidence/AC-255.txt (HEAD wiring; pin grep empty; b6df7059 in a8bc66e2)
external: https://gameaccessibilityguidelines.com/basic/ (accessed 2026-11-07): "Offer a wide choice of difficulty levels"
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. The record is stale for HEAD.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record: fixed at b6df7059, still open on /play/ until the pin moves.

verdicts.claim: There is no text-size option, and contrast per role is not measured (HUD spec to-do).
verdicts.what_is_true: Text size is missing from the public pin but present in HEAD and the LAN builds since b6df7059. Contrast is still unmeasured everywhere: hud-spec.md:398 still lists 'Set minimum contrast per role' as a to-do, and no check in ui/tools or tools/l10n measures contrast. Text has outlines and scrims, so the harm is low.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. The text-size half is stale for HEAD.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record for text size. Write the missing contrast-per-role check (UI with Art) before a store build.

verdicts.claim: Captions have nothing to caption (no live bark line reaches the HUD) and grunts are uncaptioned; fix before voices ship (about_voice gate).
verdicts.what_is_true: Still true at HEAD. The live bark emitter exists (e4be0c65) but is switched off (enabled false), and the pin has no emitter at all. Grunts carry captions in data (16 entries) and on each sound cue, but nothing in render/ or ui/ reads them, so none is shown. 'about_voice gate' is a misreading: that flag only shows a sentence on the About page.
proof: evidence/AC-257.txt (no reader of cue.caption outside audio/; live_barks enabled false at HEAD and a8bc66e2)
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. The about_voice wording could make people treat a disclosure flag as a voice-release gate.
verdicts.fix: Show grunt captions in the HUD caption line when Captions is on, and turn on the bark caption path with live barks. Correct the about_voice wording.

verdicts.claim: There is no screen reader or menu narration (no tts_speak), and the canvas-drawn menus have no accessibility tree.
verdicts.what_is_true: No committed .gd or .tscn file has a tts_ call or an accessibility_* property, and the menus are drawn by hand on a CanvasItem. So no build exposes its menus to a screen reader. The guidelines' Basic list has no screen-reader item, so this is a gap at a higher tier, relevant to a store build.
external: https://gameaccessibilityguidelines.com/basic/ (accessed 2026-11-07): checked, no screen-reader guideline in the Basic list
verdicts.fix: Keep it as a P5 or store item for UI: text-to-speech narration of the menus.

verdicts.claim: Orb's rule: accessibility settings and customizable controls are assumed, including a left-handed swap; eight rules follow.
verdicts.what_is_true: Orb's rule is real (2026-10-30) and mostly built: hand layout, D-pad mirror, strike and brace styles, one-stick mode, a swapped keyboard preset, SimSwap, and the claw gate run on the swapped pad. On a pad, rule 5 is not met by default, because no brace or vanish button is bound (see AC-252). Rule 1 still has 'Left thumb' in howto.json:50, and the checklist (row 12) does not exist.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: It puts a product requirement on the release-safety list. Its one real defect is already AC-252.
verdicts.fix: Move it to Accessibility and Controls as Orb's product requirement, and track rows 2, 9, 11 and 12 there.

verdicts.claim: Beam alert accessibility: a solid plate with 4.5:1 text contrast, split visual/sound/buzz strength, a captioned sound, Calm/Standard/Full presets, and a dodge-zone notch.
verdicts.what_is_true: The record's 'not built' is stale. The alert was built at d5582dbd (2026-11-07) with a solid backing plate, Calm/Standard/Full presets, separate sound and buzz rows and a dodge-zone notch, but it is switched off (answer_alert false). The 4.5:1 figure matches WCAG SC 1.4.3 for web text and works here as a design margin. It is not measured, and the alert sound has no caption.
external: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html (accessed 2026-11-07): SC 1.4.3, Level AA, "contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1"
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Small: a design brief for a feature that is off, sitting in the safety records. It implies a contrast check runs when none does.
verdicts.fix: Move it to the UI and Accessibility design notes. Before answer_alert is switched on, measure the contrast of the plate text and add the sound caption.

verdicts.claim: Gameplay assists that change outcomes must be deterministic and recorded in match settings and the replay header; their use in versus, ranked and online is Orb's call.
verdicts.what_is_true: None of the named assists exists: there is no late-answer grace and no wider chord or slip window in data or sim. The principle already holds for today's assists, because the setup's 'assists' list is copied into the replay header. Allowing them in versus or ranked is a fairness decision for Orb and Game Design, not release safety.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: It keeps a fairness policy for features that do not exist on the safety list.
verdicts.fix: Move it to Game Design's open questions for Orb, and raise it again when an assist that changes outcomes is built.

verdicts.claim: Colour-blind options without a palette change: no colour-only cue, three presets as a second route, lane colours CIEDE2000 20 or more apart.
verdicts.what_is_true: Orb's direction is real (vision.md:817), and the presets are wired in both the pin and HEAD. I re-measured with the repo's own colour-vision matrices: the two fighters' lane colours are 34.9, 36.6 and 31.0 apart (CIEDE2000). But under deutan the closest wound-stage colour sits 19.6 from a lane colour, and UI's own note gives 19.9 while claiming 'at least 20'. The 20 is the project's own margin, not a standard.
proof: evidence/AC-262.txt (de00 re-measure; readers of colour_vision at HEAD and 257a766c)
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Little. A design rule that is already met adds review load when carried as safety.
verdicts.fix: Move it to UI and Art. Either change the note's 'at least 20' to the measured deutan minimum, or adjust one deutan stage colour.

verdicts.claim: Three controller layouts plus full keyboard and pad remapping for both players ship; N, T, Y, P and Escape are reserved; menu routes for them unverified.
verdicts.what_is_true: Remapping is on, and N, T, Y, P and Escape are reserved. But the pin and HEAD have only two pad layouts (arena and simple-pad, no Brawler), so ADR 0008's 'three layouts ship' is not what ships. Menu routes mostly exist: the pause menu has New match and Resume, the start menu sets 1 or 2 players, and any key hands P1 to the player.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Low. A P3 about 'unverified routes' stays open although the routes exist, and the ADR's three-layout promise reads as shipped.
verdicts.fix: Move it to Controls and UI and correct the record: two pad layouts, routes found for N, P, T and Y. Ask Orb whether a Brawler layout is still wanted.

verdicts.claim: Guard, Transform and three stances were hold-only, with no toggle (P2).
verdicts.what_is_true: Fixed in HEAD and the LAN builds since 5d26c626 (2026-10-28): guard, manoeuvre, charge and transform each have hold or toggle per player. The public pin still has only energy_style, with 'Hold to guard.' and Transform's half-second hold. So /play/ still requires holding for players who cannot hold buttons.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a finding. The record's 'superseded' is right for HEAD but not for /play/.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record: fixed at 5d26c626, still open on /play/ until the pin moves.

batch_notes: Five A9 records (AC-251, 254, 255, 256, 264) are fixed in HEAD and the LAN builds but still true on /play/, which serves pin 257a766c (2026-10-19). None of those fixes can reach /play/ while CI is dead and the deploy is blocked.

One live defect in the private builds: the brace_style help names L3 on Arena, but no pad preset binds brace_key, so 'Button only' leaves a pad player with no brace (AC-252). The inventory's 'possibly fixed' is wrong.
Inventory note errors: AC-255's options.json grep looked in the wrong file (the level is on the start menu); AC-260's 'not built' is stale (built at d5582dbd, switched off).
No A9 claim reaches S1. None of the records cites an accessibility law, and I did not check whether one applies to a free game.
